Weekly tips for returning guests
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travelers should read this before they head out with a pet.
Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping the focus on safe, calm travel, and that starts with clear papers, clean carriers, and steady communication from the first check-in note to the final handoff. If your plans have changed, tell the desk right away so we can adjust the file and avoid last-minute stress for you and your animal.

We are seeing more rushed handovers than usual, and that slows everyone down. Please bring the items you were told about, keep your pet secure, and speak up if anything about the journey feels off. The desk team gives plain guidance before departure because a little care now prevents a bigger problem later. Respectful messages help us solve issues faster, and we will always answer in the same direct way.

If you are traveling with a young pet, an anxious pet, or a companion that needs extra support, say so early and keep the details simple. That gives the team a fair chance to prepare without confusion. Safety stays ahead of speed on every trip, even when the airport feels busy.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you move on.
